title: Stable least squares with QR and the SVD
brief: Solve least squares through QR and the SVD without forming X^T X, return the shortest weights for repeated columns, and count the rank.
hints: fit_qr: Q, R = np.linalg.qr(X, mode='reduced'), then solve_triangular(R, Q.T @ y, lower=False).
fit_svd: U, s, vt = np.linalg.svd(X, full_matrices=False). keep = s > rcond * s[0]. Use U[:, keep], s[keep], and vt[keep], so the tiny singular values are dropped instead of divided by.
rank: s = np.linalg.svd(X, compute_uv=False), then count the entries above rcond * s[0]. Handle s[0] == 0 by returning 0.
